title: 第0009章武道馆秘辛血脉预警第0010章低语温泉气血测试

凌晨五点的凰溪岛，天刚蒙蒙亮，海面泛起鱼肚白，咸湿的海风裹挟着淡淡的灵气，吹过后山的修炼平台。
贾黑米已经站在平台中央，汗水顺着脸颊滑落，浸湿了胸前的粗布衣衫。他双目紧闭，呼吸绵长而有节奏，丹田内的气血按照叶利西传授的《清心诀》运转路线缓缓流淌，每一次循环，都能感觉到气血变得更加凝练。
自从昨晚服下清心丹，又修炼了半宿的磐石拳，他的气血已经稳定在7.5卡，虽然距离10卡的高考合格线还有差距，但这种肉眼可见的进步，让他心中充满了干劲。
“呼——”
贾黑米缓缓吐出一口浊气，睁开双眼，眸中闪过一丝精光。他抬手一拳打出，气血顺着经脉涌向拳峰，带着沉闷的破空声，拳风扫过，将身前的空气撕裂出一道微不可查的涟漪。
“不错，短短一夜，气血运转就已经如此顺畅。”叶利西的声音从身后传来，他依旧穿着那件洗得发白的粗布衣衫，手里拿着一个竹篮，里面装着新鲜的草药，“《清心诀》重在养心，《磐石拳》重在炼体，两者相辅相成，既能提升气血，又能稳固心神，正好契合你的心灵破障天赋。”
贾黑米转过身，恭敬地行了一礼：“多亏了师父的指点，否则我就算再练十年，也未必能有这样的进步。”
“你自身的天赋和毅力才是关键。”叶利西笑了笑，将竹篮放在石桌上，“灵气复苏后，人人都想走捷径，却忘了修炼最根本的就是‘持之以恒’。你能沉下心来打磨基础，这很难得。”
他从竹篮里拿出几株墨绿色的草药，递给贾黑米：“这是‘凝神草’，配合清心丹熬制，能进一步强化你的心灵防御，抵御低语侵蚀。你今天白天先去武道馆参加集训，晚上回来我教你炼制丹药的基础手法。记住，无论在武道馆遇到什么事，都要保持心神清明，不要被外界的纷扰影响。”
“弟子明白。”贾黑米接过凝神草，小心翼翼地收进怀里。他知道，叶利西不仅在教他修炼，更在教他如何在这个危机四伏的世界里守住本心。
“去吧，小黑会跟着你，有它在，一般的诡异伤不了你。”叶利西指了指蹲在旁边的黑猫，黑猫像是听懂了他的话，纵身一跃，落在贾黑米的肩膀上，金色的瞳孔警惕地扫视着四周。
贾黑米点点头，转身朝着山下走去。清晨的山林格外安静，只有脚步声和鸟鸣声交织在一起，肩膀上的黑猫偶尔发出一声轻叫，像是在提醒他注意周围的环境。
走到度假区入口时，太阳已经升起，金色的阳光洒在沙滩上，游客们陆续醒来，度假区恢复了往日的繁华。贾黑米没有停留，径直朝着海滨武道馆走去。
海滨武道馆是凰溪岛上最大的武道培训机构，也是武道高考预选的指定考点之一。馆内设施齐全，有专业的气血测试仪器、武道训练场、实战模拟室，岛上想参加武道高考的年轻人，大多会来这里参加集训。
贾黑米走到武道馆门口时，里面已经热闹起来，不少穿着武道服的年轻人正在热身，气血波动此起彼伏。他刚一进门，就感觉到几道不友善的目光落在自己身上。
“哟，这不是我们岛上的‘废柴’贾黑米吗？昨天气血测试6.8卡，今天还敢来？”一个身材高大的青年阴阳怪气地说道，他叫张强，是武道馆的老牌学员，气血值15卡，在年轻一辈中算是中等水平，平时最喜欢欺负新人。
他身边的几个跟班也跟着起哄：“强哥，你别这么说，人家说不定是来碰运气的，万一武道高考突然开窍了呢？”
“开窍？我看他是开棺还差不多！”张强哈哈大笑起来，眼神里满是嘲讽，“20岁才6.8卡，我看他这辈子都别想通过高考，还是早点回家种地吧！”
贾黑米眉头微皱，心中泛起一丝怒意，但他很快就压了下去。现在的他，已经不是以前那个任人欺负的废柴了，他有更重要的事情要做，没必要和这些人一般见识。

他没有理会张强等人的嘲讽，径直朝着集训场地走去。肩膀上的黑猫似乎感受到了他的情绪，金色的瞳孔微微一缩，对着张强等人发出一声低沉的嘶吼，吓得几人下意识地后退了一步。
“这猫怎么回事？”张强脸色一变，他能感觉到，这只黑猫身上散发着一股让他心悸的气息。
“不知道，好像是跟着贾黑米来的。”一个跟班说道。
“哼，一只猫而已，有什么好怕的。”张强强装镇定，可心里却有些发怵，不敢再轻易挑衅。
贾黑米走到集训场地的角落，找了个空位坐下，开始热身。他刚活动了几下，就看到才依依和花呗呗走了进来。
才依依依旧穿着一身白色武道服，身姿挺拔，清冷的脸上没有丝毫表情，走到场地中央的训练区，自顾自地练起了拳。她的动作行云流水，气血运转流畅，每一拳打出，都带着凌厉的破空声，显然是常年苦练的结果。
花呗呗则穿着一身时尚的休闲装，手里拿着一个平板电脑，一边走一边刷着什么，看到贾黑米，眼睛一亮，快步走了过来。
“贾黑米，你可算来了。”花呗呗在他身边坐下，压低声音说道，“我跟你说，昨天温泉区的事情闹大了，度假区管理处已经介入调查，武道联盟也派了人过来，不过我看他们好像在刻意隐瞒什么。”
“隐瞒？”贾黑米心中一动，“隐瞒什么？”
“具体我也不清楚，不过我昨晚黑进了度假区的监控系统，发现温泉区那个发狂的男人，出事前去过海滨武道馆的地下训练室。”花呗呗晃了晃手里的平板电脑，“而且不止他一个，三天前袭击顾客的那个服务员，也在武道馆待过。”
贾黑米瞳孔骤缩，他想起叶利西昨晚说的话——岛上的诡异事件，可能和某些势力有关。难道海滨武道馆，就是这些势力的据点？
“你确定？”贾黑米问道。
“当然确定，我可是专业的。”花呗呗拍了拍胸脯，“不过那个地下训练室很神秘，只有武道馆的核心学员才能进去，我查不到里面的情况。对了，我还查到，武道馆的馆长赵天虎，最近经常和一个神秘人接触，两人每次见面都很隐蔽，像是在密谋什么。”
“赵天虎？”贾黑米皱起眉头，赵天虎是凰溪岛的老牌强者，气血值高达80卡，武师境巅峰，据说距离武王境只有一步之遥，在岛上威望很高，没想到他竟然会和诡异事件有关。
“这事不简单。”贾黑米沉声道，“武道馆是岛上年轻人修炼的地方，如果这里真的有问题，不知道会有多少人被牵连。”
“可不是嘛。”花呗呗叹了口气，“我本来想把这件事告诉武道联盟的人，可又怕打草惊蛇，而且我也没有确凿的证据。贾黑米，你现在不是跟着那位隐士高人修炼吗？要不要让他出面查查？”
贾黑米摇了摇头：“师父喜欢清静，不想被外界打扰。这件事，我们还是先暗中调查，等找到确凿的证据再说。”
就在这时，武道馆的广播突然响了起来：“各位学员请注意，今天的集训内容是实战对抗，分组情况已经贴在公告栏，请大家尽快到公告栏查看，十分钟后在实战场地集合。”

It's five o'clock in the morning on Huangxi Island. It's just dawn, the sea surface is white as fish belly, and the salty and wet sea breeze carries a faint aura and blows past the training platform on the back mountain.
Jiahemi was already standing in the center of the platform, sweat sliding down his face and soaking the coarse cloth on his chest. His eyes were closed tightly, and his breathing was long and rhythmic. The qi and blood in his dantian flowed slowly according to the "Qingxin Jue" taught by Ye Lixi. With each cycle, he could feel that the qi and blood became more condensed.
Since taking the Qingxin Pill last night and practicing Panshiquan for half a night, his energy and blood have stabilized at 7.5 calories. Although there is still a gap between the 10 calories and the college entrance examination passing line, this visible progress makes him full of motivation.
"Huh——"
Jia Heimi slowly exhaled a breath, opened his eyes, and a glimmer of light flashed in his eyes. He raised his hand and punched, and blood flowed along the meridians to the peak of the fist. With a dull sound of breaking through the air, the wind of the fist swept through and tore an undetectable ripple in the air in front of him.
"Yes, in just one night, the energy and blood flow has been so smooth." Ye Lixi's voice came from behind. He was still wearing the washed white coarse cloth clothes, holding a bamboo basket in his hand with fresh herbs. ""Qingxin Jue" focuses on nourishing the heart, and "Rock Fist" focuses on training the body. The two complement each other. They can not only improve the energy and blood, but also stabilize the mind, which is exactly in line with your talent of breaking spiritual barriers."
Jia Heimi turned around and bowed respectfully: "Thanks to Master's guidance, otherwise I may not be able to make such progress even if I practice for another ten years."
"Your own talent and perseverance are the key." Ye Lixi smiled and placed the bamboo basket on the stone table. "After the spiritual energy is revived, everyone wants to take shortcuts, but they forget that the most fundamental thing in cultivation is 'persistence.' It's rare that you can calm down and polish the foundation."
He took out a few dark green herbs from the bamboo basket and handed them to Jia Heimi: "This is the 'Spirit Condensing Grass'. When brewed with the Qingxin Pill, it can further strengthen your spiritual defense and resist the erosion of whispers. You will go to the Martial Arts Hall for training during the day. Come back in the evening and I will teach you the basic techniques for refining the pill. Remember, no matter what happens in the Martial Arts Hall, you must keep your mind clear and not be affected by external disturbances."
"Disciple understands." Jia Heimi took the Ningshen Grass and carefully put it into his arms. He knew that Ye Lixi was not only teaching him how to practice, but also teaching him how to keep his heart in this crisis-ridden world.
"Go ahead, Xiao Hei will follow you. As long as he is here, normal weirdness can't hurt you." Ye Lixi pointed to the black cat squatting next to him. The black cat seemed to understand his words, jumped up, and landed on Jia Heimi's shoulder. Its golden pupils scanned the surroundings vigilantly.
Jiahemi nodded, turned around and walked down the mountain. The mountain forest was extremely quiet in the early morning, with only the sounds of footsteps and birds chirping intertwined. The black cat on his shoulder occasionally let out a soft cry, as if to remind him to pay attention to the surrounding environment.
When we walked to the entrance of the resort, the sun had already risen, and the golden sunshine was shining on the beach. Tourists woke up one after another, and the resort returned to its former prosperity. Jiahemi didn't stop and walked straight towards the seaside martial arts gym.
The Haibin Martial Arts Center is the largest martial arts training institution on Huangxi Island, and is also one of the designated test sites for preliminaries for the martial arts college entrance examination. The museum has complete facilities, including professional qi and blood testing equipment, martial arts training ground, and actual combat simulation room. Most young people on the island who want to take the martial arts college entrance examination will come here to participate in training.
When Jia Heimi walked to the door of the martial arts hall, it was already bustling inside. Many young people in martial arts uniforms were warming up, and their energy and blood fluctuated one after another. As soon as he entered the door, he felt several unfriendly eyes falling on him.
"Hey, isn't this the 'good-for-nothing' Jia Heimi on our island? Yesterday's qi and blood test showed 6.8 calories. How dare you come today?" A tall young man said in a sinister tone. His name is Zhang Qiang., is a veteran student of the Budokan, with a health value of 15 cards, which is considered average among the younger generation. He usually likes to bully newcomers.
Several of the followers around him also started to cheer: "Brother Qiang, don't say that. He might be here to try his luck. What if he suddenly gets enlightened in the martial arts college entrance examination?"
"Enlightenment? I think he is more like opening a coffin!" Zhang Qiang laughed loudly, his eyes full of mockery, "He only has 6.8 calories at the age of 20. I think he will never pass the college entrance examination in his life, so he should go home and farm early!"
Jia Heimi frowned slightly, a trace of anger rising in his heart, but he quickly suppressed it. Now, he is no longer the loser who was bullied by others. He has more important things to do, and there is no need to be familiar with these people.
He ignored the taunts from Zhang Qiang and others and walked straight towards the training venue. The black cat on the shoulder seemed to sense his emotions, its golden pupils shrank slightly, and it let out a low roar at Zhang Qiang and others, scaring them so much that they subconsciously took a step back.
"What's going on with this cat?" Zhang Qiang's expression changed. He could feel that this black cat exuded an aura that made his heart palpitate.
"I don't know, it seems that he came with Jiahemi." A follower said.
"Humph, it's just a cat, what's there to be afraid of?" Zhang Qiang pretended to be calm, but he was a little frightened in his heart and did not dare to provoke easily.
Jiahemi walked to the corner of the training ground, found an empty seat, sat down, and started to warm up. He had just moved a few times when he saw Cai Yiyi and Hua Beibei walking in.
Cai Yiyi was still wearing a white martial arts uniform, with an upright posture and a cold face without any expression. She walked to the training area in the center of the venue and started practicing boxing by herself. Her movements were smooth and flowing, her energy and blood flowed smoothly, and every punch she punched had a sharp sound of breaking through the air, which was obviously the result of years of hard training.
Hua Beibei was wearing a fashionable casual outfit, holding a tablet in her hand, brushing something while walking. When she saw Jia Heimi, her eyes lit up and she walked over quickly.
"Jia Heimi, you're here." Huabeibai sat down next to him and said in a low voice, "Let me tell you, the incident in the hot spring area made a big fuss yesterday. The resort management office has intervened in the investigation, and the martial arts alliance has also sent people over, but I think they seem to be deliberately hiding something."
"Hide it?" Jia Heimi's heart moved, "What are you hiding?"
"I don't know the details, but I hacked into the resort's surveillance system last night and found that the crazy man in the hot spring area had been to the underground training room of the Seaside Budokan before the accident." Hua Beibei shook the tablet in her hand, "And he's not the only one. The waiter who attacked the customer three days ago also stayed at the Budokan."
Jiahemi's pupils shrank suddenly, and he remembered what Ye Lixi said last night - the strange events on the island may be related to certain forces. Could it be that the Seaside Martial Arts Hall is the stronghold of these forces?
"Are you sure?" Jiahemi asked.
"Of course I'm sure, I'm a professional." Hua Beibei patted her chest, "But the underground training room is very mysterious. Only the core students of the martial arts gym can go in. I can't find out what's going on inside. By the way, I also found out that Zhao Tianhu, the director of the martial arts gym, has been in frequent contact with a mysterious person recently. Every time they meet, they are very secretive, as if they are conspiring."
"Zhao Tianhu?" Jia Heimi frowned. Zhao Tianhu is a veteran strongman on Huangxi Island. His health value is as high as 80 cards. He is at the pinnacle of the martial arts realm. It is said that he is only one step away from the martial king realm. He has high prestige on the island. I didn't expect that he would be related to the strange events.
"This matter is not simple." Jia Heimi said solemnly, "The martial arts hall is a place for young people to practice on the island. If there is really a problem here, I don't know how many people will be implicated."
"That's right." Hua Beibei sighed, "I originally wanted to tell the people in the Martial Arts Alliance about this, but I was afraid of being taken off guard.Snakes, and I have no conclusive evidence. Jia Heimi, aren't you practicing with that hermit master now? Do you want him to come forward and investigate? "
Jia Heimi shook his head: "Master likes peace and quiet and doesn't want to be disturbed by the outside world. We should investigate this matter secretly first and wait until we find conclusive evidence. "
At this moment, the broadcast from the martial arts hall suddenly rang: "Students, please note that today's training content is actual combat. The grouping information has been posted on the bulletin board. Please check the bulletin board as soon as possible and gather at the actual battlefield in ten minutes. "
